pr_title: net: tcp2: Verify that options are read correctly
pr_body:
Remove the static buffer for TCP options. Make sure that the
options were read properly to temp buffer.

Fixes: #25729
Coverity-CID: 210056

Signed-off-by: Jukka Rissanen <jukka.rissanen@linux.intel.com>
pr_comments: Reverted the last change as that was causing NULL pointer access in tests.

review_comments: Is options == NULL an error condition?  If so, log it and return an error.
